curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: identify the letters Aa, Mm, Tt and Ee in lower case and upper case

interactions.prompt: Which is the upper-case letter for a?
interactions.feedback: Yes! A is the upper-case partner of a.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the big form of a.

interactions.prompt: Match each upper-case letter to its lower-case partner.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a big letter, then its small partner.
interactions.feedback: Perfect pairs! Each letter has an upper-case and lower-case form.
interactions.retryHint: The partners make the same sound and have the same name.

interactions.prompt: Tap the pair that shows T in both forms.
interactions.feedback: Correct! T and t are partners.
interactions.retryHint: Look for one big T and one small t.

interactions.prompt: Sort the letters into upper case and lower case.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a letter, then its group.
interactions.feedback: Nicely sorted! Big letters are upper case; small letters are lower case.
interactions.retryHint: Compare the size and shape of each letter.

interactions.prompt: A name starts with a capital letter. Which spelling begins Amina correctly?
interactions.feedback: Well done! Amina begins with upper-case A.
interactions.retryHint: Find the name with a big first letter and small letters after it.

interactions.tapAlternative: Tap each letter, then its partner.
interactions.feedback: Mission complete! You identified Aa, Mm, Tt and Ee in both forms.
interactions.retryHint: Match letters with the same name.
